_source: Quote-to-deposit billing set (2026-09-04). build/deploy_billing.py creates, per package tier, an estimate template (the quote), a deposit invoice template and a balance invoice template from the location's products, using the public Invoices API (location PIT). Ids are written to clients/<slug>-billing-ids.json and consumed by the billing workflows spec. Deposit percent is read from the Deposit Percent custom value. extra_estimates: manual-use estimate templates (the corporate one lists the package plus every add-on at qty 1 for the owner to trim; the API refuses qty 0).

estimate.title: Event Quote
estimate.name: Quote - {label}
estimate.terms: This quote holds no date. Your date is reserved once the agreement is signed and the deposit is paid. Add-ons, extra hours and travel are listed on request. Questions: {{custom_values.business_phone}}.

deposit.name: Deposit - {label}
deposit.terms: Non-refundable deposit that reserves your event date. The balance is due {{custom_values.balance_due_days_before_event}} days before the event.

balance.name: Balance - {label}
balance.terms: Remaining balance for your event. Due {{custom_values.balance_due_days_before_event}} days before the event date.

extra_estimates.name: Quote - Corporate (custom)
extra_estimates.title: Event Quote
extra_estimates.terms: Corporate quote. Every line is editable: remove the add-ons you do not need and adjust hours before sending. This quote holds no date until the agreement is signed and the deposit is paid.
